lung.name: Lung (Hand Taiyin)
lung.runs_note: Drawing order = WHO point numbering. Bladder and Stomach are split into runs so lines do not cut across between separate courses (BL inner/outer back lines, leg; ST face vs body). Internal branches are not drawn.
